title: Big Take: The Real Costs of the U.S. Iran Blockade
text:
On today's Big Take podcast, Bloomberg Global Defense Editor Gerry Doyle and Bloomberg Economics Defense Lead and adjunct senior fellow at the Center for a New American Security Becca Wasser join Sarah Holder to break down the conflict’s latest costs – the rising tab for the U.S.'s six-month-long blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, the drawdown of U.S. munitions stockpiles and the deepening toll on military personnel – and how the war has changed the U.S.'s ability to defend itself in future conflicts.
Listen to the full interview on Bloomberg.
